UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated user account, studio settings, and active Character.AI synchronization state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the authenticated user.

email.description: Email address or identifier of the user.

authProvider.description: Primary linked authentication provider (GOOGLE_EMAIL, CHARACTER_AI, APPLE_ID).

caiLinkedUsername.description: Linked Character.AI @handle for automatic character synchronization.

activeCharacterId.description: ID of the currently active synced Character.AI profile.

defaultMuteWindowMs.description: Configured Chime-Blocker post-speech holdoff window in milliseconds (300-2200).

defaultSampleRateHz.description: Configured Studio audio sample rate in Hz (48000, 44100, 24000).

defaultMonoChannel.description: Whether mono channel audio capture and export is enabled by default.

caiIntegrationEnabled.description: Whether direct native Character.AI app integration is enabled.

whatsappIntegrationEnabled.description: Whether WhatsApp PTT .opus voice note integration is enabled.

telegramIntegrationEnabled.description: Whether Telegram 48kHz .ogg voice note integration is enabled.

googleChatIntegrationEnabled.description: Whether Google Chat .ogg voice note integration is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CharacterProfile.title: CharacterProfile
CharacterProfile.description: Synchronized Character.AI character persona and 48kHz voice configuration owned by a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

characterId.description: Unique identifier for the synced character.

personaBio.description: Detailed persona backstory and speaking style.

greeting.description: Opening greeting spoken when connecting a call.

voicePresetId.description: Studio voice preset ID bound to this character.

voiceProfileName.description: Human-readable label for the character's voice configuration.

recommendedHoldoffMs.description: Recommended post-speech chime holdoff gate in milliseconds (300-2200).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user account document storing linked auth providers, studio preferences, and active Character.AI sync state.

/users/{userId}/characterProfiles/{chara.description: Per-user subcollection of synchronized Character.AI personas and 48kHz voice configurations.
